notes: Recorded live on the deployed site on 4 November 2026 in the simulator; no physical robot.
Planning used Meta's models (muse-spark-1.3, site_router); SAM 3.1 ran 44 vision checks.
Each chapter is a real-time excerpt of a screen recording of the live 3D view; time between chapters is skipped.
The run's 1018 events verify as one unbroken hash chain.
Completion does not mean every proposal was safe: refused proposals are part of the record.
